newsitem.title: DUBAI: Earthquake destroys houses in eastern Iran.
newsitem.headline: Earthquake destroys houses in eastern Iran.

text.p: An earthquake measuring 5.5 on the Richter scale on Monday jolted eastern Iran, the same area hit by a strong quake that killed more than 1,500 people in May.
The official Iranian news agency IRNA said the quake hit the areas of Qaen and Birjand at 7.30 a.m. (0300 GMT).
State Tehran Radio, monitored by the British Broadcasting Corporation, said the quake destroyed a number of houses but no one was killed.
An earthquake of force four or more could cause serious damage in populated areas.

An earthquake measuring 7.1 on the Richter scale hit the area last month, killing 1,560, injuring 2,810 and leaving 50,000 homeless. It flattened 200 villages and prompted Iran to appeal for international aid.

Iran has been hit by three major earthquakes in the past year as well as scores of milder tremors and thousands of aftershocks that U.N. officials say have stretched Iran's relief supplies to the limit.
